decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:Location Plan; EN14QY-PL-P01; EN14QY-PL-P02; EN14QY-PL-P03; EN14QY-PL-P04; EN14QY-PL-P05; EN14QY-PL-P06.Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture those specified in the approved application.Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area.

The outbuilding hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the main dwelling at number 14 Lilac Avenue and shall not be used as independent self-contained accommodation.Reason: To ensure that the development complies with adopted standards, does not impact on neighbouring amenity and is in character with the existing form of development in the locality in accordance with relevant adopted planning policies of the Enfield Local Plan.

The existing flue, which has not been included on the approved plans and therefore does not form part of the approved development, shall be removed within 6 weeks of the date of this permission. Reason: To safeguard the amenity of neighbouring residential occupiers.
description: Detached timber summer house at rear (RETROSPECTIVE).
